name: Democratic Party
description: Follow Democratic Party, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: South Carolina and Nevada Fight to Kick Off Democrats’ 2028 Presidential Calendar
changes.summary: The calendar order could be hugely important to the 2028 presidential primary race. Democratic insiders will try to sketch out a schedule this week, and rival states are sniping at one another.

changes.title: US House passes $1.15tn defense policy bill in near party-line vote
changes.summary: Passage of annual bill complicated by Trump’s decision to join Israel in attacking Iran without congressional approval The US House of Representatives passed a $1.15tn defense policy bill in a near-party-line vote on Wednesday, after Democrats refused to back the measure amid the war with Iran and Donald Trump ’s push.

changes.title: House Passes Defense Bill Amid Iran War Divide
changes.summary: Republicans pushed through the $1.15 trillion bill over opposition from Democrats, who said backing it was akin to embracing the war.

changes.title: House Narrowly Passes Stopgap Spending Bill, but Shutdown Fight Looms
changes.summary: Republicans managed to push through legislation to fund the government through Dec. 4. But with Democrats opposed, the stage is set for a broader battle.

changes.title: Senate panel advances Jay Clayton's nomination for director of national intelligence
changes.summary: The 9-8 vote came after some Democrats had praised Clayton and indicated that they might vote for him. But that shifted after a contentious hearing last week in which Clayton repeatedly refused to say that former President Joe Biden won the 2020 election.

changes.title: Democrats could take initial vote on 2028 presidential primary calendar this week
changes.summary: Democrats could vote as early as this week on the order of their primary calendar for the 2028 presidential election, although the decision wouldn't be final until the full Democratic National Committee agrees.

changes.title: Democrats’ Top Senate Candidate in Maine Won’t Support Schumer for Leader
changes.summary: Troy Jackson, who is set to become the party’s nominee, also said in an interview that he was not sure he wanted the support of Senator Chuck Schumer in the general election.

changes.title: Arizona primaries set the stage for contested fall races in a swing state
changes.summary: Arizona Democrats choose who can try to flip a Republican-held House seat, and Republicans pick their nominee to try to unseat a Democratic governor. (Image credit: Ross D. Franklin).

changes.title: Democrats avoid a messy fight in Maine, but uncertainty lingers: From the Politics Desk
changes.summary: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

changes.title: In Maine Senate Race, Democrats Go From Chaos to Coronation
changes.summary: Troy Jackson’s emergence as the clear front-runner to replace Graham Platner spares the party some challenges but points to some new ones.
